Beta candidate. Quick test, faults, readings, live data, guided tests and experimental service functions.

**New in 0.99.40:**
- **Calmer screens, nothing removed.** Each fault on the Faults page is now one line (code, state, meaning, what to do) and opens with a click to show the tip, where to look, troubleshooting, what the module stored and the sources; **Open all** opens every one at once. Dash messages on the Vehicle page are one line each and open the same way. Long explanations on the Coding, Faults, Garage, Tests and Ghost Hunter pages sit behind small **How this works** links instead of always being on screen. Safety notes stay visible.
- **Smaller fixes.** Model names in the Garage no longer break across lines (the years now sit under the engine). The footwell module notice above the car is one line, with the full rules under **Details**. The Vehicle page's actions use one button style.

**Downloads:** unzip and run Klemme15 (Klemme15.exe on Windows). The command-line tool is in the cli folder. EDIABAS mode (your own BMW files) is included in every build.

Earlier versions: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Expos-AI/Klemme15/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
